# CG-REQ-003: Request body property became required

An existing optional request property is now required.

**Why it matters:** Requests that omitted an optional property become invalid.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Requests](./#req) |
| Direction | request |
| Detects | `schema.requiredChanged` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: medium · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> Property "{property}" became required in {where}.
>
> Consumers that omit "{property}" will be rejected.
>
> **Fix:** Keep "{property}" optional with a server-side default, or release as a new major version.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: b added to required

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, properties: {a: {}, b: {}}}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, required: [b], properties: {a: {}, b: {}}}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** Breaking, high. Property "b" became required in POST /x: the request body (application/json).

### Does not fire: readOnly property

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, properties: {a: {}, b: {readOnly: true}}}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, required: [b], properties: {a: {}, b: {readOnly: true}}}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.

### Does not fire: response direction

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, properties: {a: {}, b: {}}}}}}}
+       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {type: object, required: [b], properties: {a: {}, b: {}}}}}}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.

## Limitations

- A server-side default for missing values cannot be seen in the specification.
